# Security & API Contract Checklist: Production Readiness

**Purpose**: Check that the security and API-contract requirements of feature 002 are complete, clear, consistent
and measurable before `/speckit-implement`. This is a formal gate for the reviewer.

**Created**: 2026-09-25

**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [data-model.md](../data-model.md) ·
[phonebook-api-changes.openapi.yaml](../contracts/phonebook-api-changes.openapi.yaml) ·
[identity-signin.md](../contracts/identity-signin.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.

**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness: Sign-in & Credentials

- [ ] CHK001 Are lifetimes specified for authorization codes and end-user access tokens, or is it stated that they are left to OpenIddict's defaults? [Gap, Spec §FR-018, contracts/identity-signin.md]
- [ ] CHK002 Is a lifetime or expiry specified for the sign-in session (cookie)? [Gap, Spec §US4]
- [ ] CHK003 Are sign-out requirements defined, or is sign-out explicitly listed as out of scope? [Gap, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK004 Does the spec itself (not only the contract) require protection against cross-site request forgery on the sign-in form? [Gap, Spec §FR-021, contracts/identity-signin.md §Login]
- [ ] CHK005 Are security attributes of the sign-in cookie specified (HTTP-only, same-site policy, secure-only over HTTPS)? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK006 Is it specified whether per-account lockout after repeated failures is required, or intentionally replaced by per-address rate limiting? [Gap, Assumption, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK007 Is it explicitly required that no seeded end users exist outside the development environment? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions "End users come from configuration"]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the password-hashing requirement stated with a measurable strength criterion (algorithm or work factor), not only "stored as hashes"? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions]

## Requirement Clarity: Sign-in & Authorization

- [ ] CHK009 Is the permitted proof-key method specified (only S256; `plain` refused), rather than just "a mandatory proof key"? [Clarity, Spec §FR-018, contracts/identity-signin.md §Authorization endpoint]
- [ ] CHK010 Does FR-021's "does not reveal whether an account exists" cover response timing as well as message text? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-021]
- [ ] CHK011 Is redirect-URI validation defined as an exact match against registered URIs? [Clarity, contracts/identity-signin.md §Authorization endpoint]
- [ ] CHK012 Is "error page / `invalid_request`" for an unknown client or redirect URI specified as one definite outcome? [Ambiguity, contracts/identity-signin.md]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the open-redirect rule for the sign-in return address (local addresses only) stated in the spec as well as the contract? [Consistency, Spec §US4, contracts/identity-signin.md §Login]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK014 Is silent down-scoping (bob asking for write gets read only) consistent with spec US4 AC4's "access is granted or refused by exactly the same rules"? Is the choice of down-scoping over an error recorded in the spec? [Conflict, Spec §US4-AC4, contracts/identity-signin.md]
- [ ] CHK015 Do the contract and the tasks agree on the result of a token request with a missing `code_verifier` (`invalid_grant` or `invalid_request`)? [Conflict, contracts/identity-signin.md §Token endpoint, tasks.md]
- [ ] CHK016 Is rate limiting of the sign-in form (constitution v1.0.2, Principle VI) reflected in the spec's FR-008, which names only the token endpoint? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the list of endpoints exempt from rate limiting consistent across spec FR-010 (health checks), data-model §2 (health checks and API documentation) and the Identity discovery endpoint? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, data-model §2]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the use of `temporarily_unavailable` on the token endpoint justified? RFC 6749 defines that error for the authorization endpoint only. [Consistency, contracts/identity-signin.md §Rate limiting]
- [ ] CHK019 Are the API version (`v1`, unchanged) and the contract's `info.version: "1.1"` described consistently, as a breaking change to the unchanged `v1` route? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, contracts/phonebook-api-changes.openapi.yaml]

## API Contract Quality: Paging & Errors

- [ ] CHK020 Are the paged response's field names and types defined identically in data-model §1 and the `ContactPage` schema, including `hasNext`'s definition? [Consistency, data-model §1, contract `ContactPage`]
- [ ] CHK021 Are the defaults and limits (page 1, size 50, maximum 200) stated identically in spec FR-002, data-model §1 and the contract parameters? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK022 Is "by character code" ordering defined precisely enough to be tested, for example as Unicode code-point order with an id tie-break? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, research R-02]
- [ ] CHK023 Is handling of empty, non-numeric and out-of-range paging values specified in the contract as well as the data model? [Completeness, data-model §1, contract parameters]
- [ ] CHK024 Are the per-field error keys (`page`, `pageSize`) and codes (`Paging.Page.Invalid`, `Paging.PageSize.Invalid`) specified in the contract's 400 response? [Completeness, contract, data-model §4]
- [ ] CHK025 Does the spec or contract require any communication or migration guidance for existing callers of the breaking tag-search change, beyond the README note? [Gap, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK026 Is the `traceId` format change (from the full `traceparent` to the 32-hex trace id) recorded as a change in the API contract? [Gap, Spec §FR-013, data-model §3]

## API Contract Quality: Rate-Limit Responses

- [ ] CHK027 Is the `Retry-After` format specified (whole seconds, never below 1) for both the API and the Identity 429 responses? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009, contract `TooManyRequests`]
- [ ] CHK028 Is the 429 response declared for every rate-limited API operation, not only in the delta's description text? [Completeness, contracts/phonebook-api-changes.openapi.yaml]
- [ ] CHK029 Is it specified which status wins when a request is both over the limit and unauthenticated or forbidden (429 or 401/403)? [Gap, Spec §FR-007, research R-03]
- [ ] CHK030 Is it specified whether informational rate-limit headers (limit, remaining) are returned, or intentionally left out? [Gap, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK031 Is the response a person sees when the sign-in **form** is rate-limited defined? The contract gives it the OAuth JSON body meant for API clients. [Gap, contracts/identity-signin.md §Login, §Rate limiting]

## Edge Case & Recovery Coverage

- [ ] CHK032 Is the required outcome defined for tokens already issued when an authorization code is replayed (for example revoking them, as OAuth security guidance recommends)? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §Edge Cases "Sign-in replay", Spec §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK033 Are requirements defined for a user who holds none of the requested scopes, and for a request that omits `scope`? [Edge Case, Gap, contracts/identity-signin.md]
- [ ] CHK034 Are recovery paths defined for an expired or abandoned sign-in (an expired code, or the session expiring between login and redirect)? [Recovery, Gap, Spec §US4]
- [ ] CHK035 Is the rate-limit identity behind a reverse proxy defined (which source address counts), or recorded as a deployment assumption in the spec? [Assumption, Spec §Edge Cases "Rate-limit identity", research R-03]

## Data Protection (Telemetry & Logs)

- [ ] CHK036 Does FR-016's list of personal data include end-user user names, passwords and client IP addresses, or say explicitly that IP addresses are allowed? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK037 Is "logs derived from telemetry" (US3 AC5) defined clearly enough to show whether existing application logs (Serilog request logs) fall under the personal-data rule? [Ambiguity, Spec §US3-AC5]
- [ ] CHK038 Is it required that request bodies (form fields such as passwords and client secrets) are never recorded in telemetry or logs? [Gap, Spec §FR-016]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
- Several items (CHK014, CHK015, CHK018, CHK031, CHK032) point to real gaps or conflicts in the current artifacts, not only
  to wording. Resolve them in spec.md or the contracts with `/speckit-specify` or `/speckit-plan`, or accept them
  explicitly inline.
